---
title: "Support boundaries"
---

The handbook provides general educational guidance. It does not provide emergency assistance, counselling, legal or medical advice, ethics approval, formal research-integrity findings, complaints investigation, or case management.

## Seek local help promptly

Contact the relevant emergency, health, safety, counselling, graduate research, integrity, ethics, privacy, human resources, student advocacy or complaints service when the situation involves immediate danger, serious distress, participant harm, bullying or harassment, discrimination, suspected misconduct, a privacy or security breach, legal threats, or pressure to act outside an approval.

Do not submit sensitive case details to the public repository. Keep the public suggestion general and use confidential local channels for the case itself.

## Method and policy boundaries

The handbook cannot determine whether a particular method is valid for a specific study or whether a local policy has been satisfied. Use qualified methodological supervision and the current official requirements for your institution, jurisdiction, funder, publisher and approval body.
